summary: Staggered license activation + air-gapped laptop prep for overnight international hire
description: Issue summary: New international engineer (temp contractor, starts 2026-02-15 07:00 UTC) needs an air-gapped dev laptop and staged access activation. Some license services (SSO group sync, MDM enrollment, license key server) replicate slowly across regions which risks leaving the hire unable to sign in during first-day onboarding. We need an operational plan to do a controlled, staggered activation during an overnight maintenance window and to prepare an air-gapped laptop image with KMS escrow so the device can be handed over locally without exposing secrets.
impact: Potential first-day productivity loss and support overhead if the contractor cannot sign in or enroll device. Risk of delayed key provisioning for air-gapped device which could block work and generate repeated access tickets.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate a new user account created in staging AD with org unit 'contractors/international'
2) Trigger SCIM provisioning and verify group membership propagation to SSO provider (Okta) in us-west region
3) Attempt MDM enrollment and license server handshake from an isolated network segment mirroring air-gapped handoff
4) Observe replication delays and enrollment failures when SSO groups are not yet propagated
logs: 2026-02-14T02:10Z okta.provisioning WARN: group membership for 'ct-berlin-21' not found
2026-02-14T02:12Z mdm-enroll ERROR: enrollment rejected: missing license-token from license-service (503 backend timeout)
2026-02-14T02:18Z scim-api INFO: created user a.berlin@example.com -> provisioning job queued job_id=job-48a3
investigation_notes: Observed 8-12 minute replication lag between SCIM create in staging AD and Okta group visibility for the us-west replica. License key server sometimes falls back to primary region; during primary region maintenance the license service returns 503. Air-gapped laptop enrollment requires pre-staging KMS-wrapped license tokens and an MDM profile that does not require live contacts to license server on first boot.
comments: 2026-02-14 03:05 - Jonas Meyer (assignee): I reproduced the SCIM->Okta lag locally using a staging tenant. Propose pre-creating the Okta groups and adding the user to them manually during the handoff window to avoid dependency on replication timing.
2026-02-14 04:20 - Hardware Ops (comment): We can image the laptop tonight and stash a sealed USB with the KMS-wrapped token. Need KMS team signoff for escrow and an HSM unseal runbook.
2026-02-14 07:00 - HR (comment): Contractor travel ETA updated to 2026-02-15 06:30 UTC local. Please prioritize; training session scheduled at 09:00.

2026-02-16 09:30 - Aisha Patel (reporter): Updated with confirmation that the laptop handoff succeeded but one secondary tool (internal telemetry uploader) failed initially and required a manual service token refresh. Leaving in-progress until follow-ups are done.
resolution: Workaround implemented: pre-create Okta groups and manually add the contractor account during the overnight window; image prepared with KMS-wrapped license token on sealed USB and MDM profile allowing first-boot offline enrollment. Manual token refresh procedure documented for telemetry tool. No permanent code changes deployed; changes limited to runbook and hardware prep.
follow_up_items: 1) Runbook update: Add a section for 'overnight international onboarding' describing manual Okta group pre-creation and sealed-token handoff
2) KMS/HSM: Approve and document the escrow workflow to generate sealed tokens for air-gapped devices
3) Onboarding scripts: Evaluate adding asynchronous post-provision polling for Okta group visibility with exponential backoff (low-priority enhancement)
4) Schedule a retrospective with HR, Hardware Ops, IAM to refine SLAs for first-day sign-in for international hires
